Content:
Editor code lives in Assets/Scripts/Editor (assembly ProceduralCreature.Editor, root ns ProceduralCreature.Editor, includePlatforms [Editor], references Runtime). Editor OWNS sessions, undo, previews, scene handles, and Unity editor lifecycle. Runtime never references Editor. Internal editor members visible only to ProceduralCreature.Tests.Editor via Editor AssemblyInfo InternalsVisibleTo.

SESSION PERSISTENCE: CreatureEditorSession (Assets/Scripts/Editor/CreatureEditorSession.cs, public static) stores the in-progress CreatureDefinition as JSON in SessionState under key "ProceduralCreature.WorkingDefinitionJson". API: Save, TryLoad, Clear. Uses JsonDnaSerializer (IDnaSerializer). Deliberate choice: SessionState survives domain reload but NOT editor restart (resolves delta-audit #5). TryLoad returns null on DnaDeserializationException rather than throwing.

UNDO: CreatureUndoState (Assets/Scripts/Editor/CreatureUndoState.cs, public sealed : ScriptableObject) - minimal in-memory [SerializeField] string _json wrapper (public Json property) whose only job is to give Unity's native Undo a serializable UnityEngine.Object anchor. Created via ScriptableObject.CreateInstance + HideFlags.HideAndDontSave in CreatureEditorWindow.OnEnable, destroyed in OnDisable. Never saved as asset. Reason: CreatureDefinition is a plain C# object so cannot be Undo.RecordObject target.

WINDOW: CreatureEditorWindow (public sealed : EditorWindow). Single mutation funnel MutateDefinition/ReplaceDefinition/ApplyDefinitionChange (every GUI edit clones -> mutates -> revalidates -> hooks Undo). Methods: OnEnable/OnDisable, OnGUI, DrawToolbar, CreateNew/SaveCurrent/SaveAs/WriteToDisk/LoadFromDisk (disk save/load via JsonDnaSerializer), DrawPartList (tree), DrawPartInspector + per-domain inspectors (DrawBodyInspector, DrawLimbFields, DrawAppearanceFields, DrawShapeFields, DrawMeshGeometryFields, DrawSymmetryFields), DrawValidationPanel, DrawSkeletonOverlay, OnSceneGUI, part-type plumbing (NewGenericPart, AddNewPart, RemoveSelectedPart, SelectPart; expanded-ID tree state via EditorPrefs key ProceduralCreature.ExpandedPartIds). Owns preview GameObject, generation config, placement mode, auto-regeneration delay, ShowWindow static entry. Editor settings pref keys ProceduralCreature.* (AutoRegenerationDelay, PreviewVoxelsPerUnit, ShowSkeleton, GenerationConfig, LogGenerationDiagnostics, CurrentFilePath).

PREVIEW STATE MODEL (A7.x async generation): CreaturePreviewController (internal sealed, IDisposable) owns a CreatureGenerationScheduler, a CreaturePreviewRequestState, injected material resolvers, the preview GameObject ("CreatureCreator Preview") and per-geometry children ("CreatureCreator Preview Geometry N"). Enqueue clones definition, forces VoxelsPerUnit, enqueues on runtime scheduler, calls _requestState.BeginRequest. ProcessCompletions pulls completed results and (A7.2) only replaces preview if result snapshot revision still matches live definition via TryAcceptResult. ApplyPreviewGeometry/ApplyPreviewMesh build scene GameObject/MeshFilter/MeshRenderer/MeshCollider; ClearGeometryObjects + Dispose clean up via DestroyImmediate. CreaturePreviewRequestState (internal sealed, PURE/testable): records current request id and decides whether a completed result is the current request (stale discard); no scene/editor-window dependency; request ids = scheduler monotonic sequence; methods BeginRequest, IsCurrentRequest, TryAcceptResult, Clear, HasPendingRequest. CreaturePreviewAcceptanceState (internal sealed, pure): stores last-accepted revisionId + placementFingerprint; Accept/IsStale/Clear/HasAcceptedPreview; decides whether applied preview is stale for placement.

OWNERSHIP: window owns preview lifecycle; CreaturePreviewController owns creation/destruction of transient preview scene GameObjects + collider; acceptance state holds identity (revision+fingerprint). Async generation executes on RUNTIME CreatureGenerationScheduler (no editor dependency) and results marshaled back in ProcessCompletions.

AUTHORING TOOLS (pure math, no UnityEditor API where possible -> EditMode-testable): BodySplineAuthoring (public static) pure body-spline editing (add sample, space-evenly, FABRIK equal-link baseline DragSampleEvenly, renumber canonical 1..N) preserving even-spacing validator invariant. BodyEditSolver (BodyEditKind {InteriorBend, EndpointLength}, BodyEditResult, static) SolveInteriorDrag/SolveEndpointDrag (local curve edit over selected sample +/- up to 3 neighbors; CC-016). BodyPlacementAuthoring (public static, CC-007) TryProjectToAnchor maps preview-mesh hit (position+normal) to semantic BodySurfaceAnchor in canonical renumbered sample-ID space. BodySampleRadiusHandle (public static) radial radius-drag math ComputeRadius/GetHandlePosition. LimbAuthoring (public static, CC-018) seed/reconcile limb chains by PartType (IsLimbChainType = Limb/Leg/Arm; Foot/Hand attachments), joint ordering, root-at-origin invariant. PartSiblingOrderer (internal IPartSiblingOrderer, AlphabeticalPartSiblingOrderer default + GroupedPartSiblingOrderer, PartSiblingOrderers {Alphabetical, Grouped}) presentation-only tree ordering, never touches DNA. SkeletonDisplay (public static, CC-066) pure view data converting inferred rest Skeleton to BoneLine primitives for read-only scene overlay.

KNOWN STALE DOC: Assets/Scripts/README.md documents only CreatureEditorSession, CreatureUndoState, CreatureEditorWindow and an old Phase structure - it does NOT mention authoring tools, preview states, BodyEditSolver, SkeletonDisplay, or A7 changes. Do not rely on it as a current editor map.
Title: CreatureCreator Editor Layer and Preview State Model
